portal.editionNote: JABSOM runs the Legacy portal, not Enterprise. Vendor documentation exists in both flavors and the screens differ. Every vendor link here is the Legacy article.

contacts.note: First stop for portal access, permissions, and anything that is not working.

vendorTicketPolicy: OME files vendor tickets, not course directors. If you hit something that looks like an ExamSoft defect, send it to Jesse so the ticket carries the institution context the vendor needs.
footerNote: Maintained by the Office of Medical Education. Content lives in data files in this repository. See the README for how to update it.
